svg.title: Nigeria: advertising cost per person who started the survey, in radius areas around towns, 2024–2026
svg.desc: Abuja and Suleja: 24 radius areas of 4 km $0.11 (8,553 started); Abuja's south side and Kuje: 19 radius areas of 4 km $0.37 (4,710 started); Yola–Jimeta: one radius area of 53 km $0.73 (748 started); South-west of Abuja around Kuje: one radius area of 19 km $1.45 (2,205 started); Lafia and Keffi: 60 radius areas of 4 km $3.65 (1,887 started); Karu, on Abuja's edge in Nasarawa: 4 radius areas of 4 km $7.50 (1,264 started); Giade: one radius area of 10 miles (16 km) $8.05 (52 started); Nasarawa town and Akwanga: 2 radius areas of 24 km $8.37 (234 started); Gamawa: one radius area of 18 miles (29 km) $9.28 (61 started); Yola–Jimeta: 23 radius areas of 2 km $10.32 (1,528 started); Jama'are: one radius area of 10 miles (16 km) $12.02 (53 started); Toro: one radius area of 16 km $14.42 (116 started).
